about: The secret of the Third Sunday of Advent. The offering is to do two things: complete the rite, and work in those who make it.

seg.tr: May the offering of our devotion, we pray, O Lord, be sacrificed to You without ceasing, that it may both carry out the ordinances of the sacred mystery and wondrously work Your salvation in us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: may fulfill the rites of the sacred mystery
may wondrously work Your salvation in us
who lives and reigns with You
